custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the white flower boutonniere and the black suit lapel. AI models often struggle with high-contrast thin objects like flower stems, causing them to blur or fuse into the dark fabric. Also, verify the tie knot structure; it should have a distinct triangular geometry and not appear as a amorphous blob of fabric.
